# awscontrib_connect_quick_connects (Data Source)

Lists Amazon Connect quick connects in an instance. Optional type and case-sensitive literal name filters are applied to results. When `tags` is set, Amazon Connect searches for resources matching every exact key-value pair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connect_instance_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Amazon Connect instance identifier."
}

variable "quick_connect_name_contains" {
  type        = string
  description = "Case-sensitive literal substring matched against quick-connect names."
  default     = "Support"
}

variable "quick_connect_tags" {
  type        = map(string)
  description = "Exact tag key-value pairs that each quick connect must match."
  default = {
    environment = "example"
  }
}

data "awscontrib_connect_quick_connects" "example" {
  instance_id         = var.connect_instance_id
  name_contains       = var.quick_connect_name_contains
  quick_connect_types = ["QUEUE", "PHONE_NUMBER"]
  tags                = var.quick_connect_tags
}

output "quick_connect_ids" {
  value = [for quick_connect in data.awscontrib_connect_quick_connects.example.quick_connects : quick_connect.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier.

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Optional case-sensitive literal substring that quick-connect names must contain.
- `quick_connect_types` (Set of String) Optional quick-connect types to return: USER, QUEUE, PHONE_NUMBER, or FLOW.
- `tags` (Map of String) Optional exact tag key-value pairs. Results must match every pair.

### Read-Only

- `quick_connects` (Attributes List) Quick-connect summaries sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quick_connects))

<a id="nestedatt--quick_connects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quick_connects`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) Quick-connect Amazon Resource Name, when returned.
- `id` (String) Quick-connect identifier.
- `last_modified_region` (String) AWS Region where the quick connect was last modified, when returned.
- `last_modified_time` (String) Time the quick connect was last modified, formatted as RFC 3339, when returned.
- `name` (String) Quick-connect name, when returned.
- `quick_connect_type` (String) Quick-connect type, when returned.
